items.example: She blew off my birthday dinner.
items.simple: You do not go or do something, and you do not care.
dialogue: A: Why didn't you come?
B: I wanted to blow off the meeting.
A: Bad idea. The boss was there.
items.note: The Office ve Seinfeld'te umursamaz karakterler.

items.example: I can't believe I fell for that trick.
items.simple: You love someone, or you believe a trick by mistake.
dialogue: A: He sent me a prize email.
B: Please tell me you didn't fall for it.
A: Of course not. Well, almost.
items.note: İkili anlamı vardır: aşk ve kandırılma.

items.example: They goof off at work all afternoon.
items.simple: You play around when you should work.
dialogue: A: Where's the report?
B: Sorry, I was busy trying to goof off.
A: You have an hour. Go.
items.note: The Office'te Jim ve Dwight'ın tembellikleri.

items.example: A guy hit on me at the gym.
items.simple: You try to start a love talk with someone, often in a pushy way.
dialogue: A: Was that man trying to hit on you?
B: Yes, with a terrible joke.
A: What did he say?
items.note: HIMYM ve Brooklyn Nine-Nine'da flört komedisi.

items.example: My roommate kicked me out of the apartment.
items.simple: You make someone leave a place.
dialogue: A: Why are you on my couch?
B: She wants to kick out the guy upstairs.
A: Ha. That's not what I asked.
items.note: Roommate sahnelerinde çok geçer.

items.example: Stop fooling around and help me clean.
items.exampleTr: Oyalanmayı bırak da temizliğe yardım et.
items.simple: You do silly things and do not do real work.
dialogue: A: Boys, don't fool around in the kitchen!
B: Sorry, Mom.
A: Dinner is in five minutes.
items.note: Malcolm in the Middle'da kardeşler arasında.

items.example: He always makes an excuse to leave early.
items.exampleTr: Hep erken çıkmak için bahane uyduruyor.
items.simple: You say a reason that is not true, so you can avoid something.
dialogue: A: Why is Dave leaving already?
B: He'll make an excuse. He hates parties.
A: Then why did he come?
items.note: Seinfeld ve Malcolm in the Middle'da klasik.

items.example: I told a white lie about the gift.
items.exampleTr: Hediye hakkında zararsız bir yalan söyledim.
items.simple: A small lie that is told to be kind.
dialogue: A: Did you love my cooking?
B: I had to tell a white lie.
A: Rude! I worked hard.
items.note: Seinfeld'de yalan komedisinin temeli.

items.tr: rezil olmak, kendini gülünç duruma düşürmek
items.example: I made a fool of myself at the party.
items.simple: You do something silly and people laugh at you.
dialogue: A: Don't make a fool of yourself tonight.
B: I never do.
A: You danced on a table once.
items.note: The Office'te Michael Scott'ın uzmanlık alanı.

items.example: Can I take a rain check on dinner?
items.exampleTr: Yemeği başka bir zamana erteleyebilir miyim?
items.simple: You say no now, but maybe yes another day.
dialogue: A: Are you coming tonight?
B: Can I take a rain check?
A: Sure. Next week then.
items.note: Davet reddederken nazik yol.

items.example: My computer is acting up again.
items.simple: Something that should work well starts to do bad things.
dialogue: A: Why is the car so loud?
B: It likes to act up when it's cold.
A: Let's call a mechanic.
items.note: Malcolm in the Middle'da çocukların davranışı için.

items.example: Sorry to butt in, but dinner is ready.
items.exampleTr: Araya girdiğim için üzgünüm ama yemek hazır.
items.simple: You speak when two other people are talking, and nobody asked you.
dialogue: A: Please don't butt in again.
B: I only wanted to help.
A: Then help by being quiet.
items.note: Modern Family ve Seinfeld'te komşu/akraba sahneleri.

items.example: He clammed up when the police asked questions.
items.exampleTr: Polis soru sorunca bir anda sustu.
items.simple: You stop talking because you are scared or shy.
dialogue: A: Why did he suddenly clam up?
B: He saw his boss walk in.
A: Awkward.
items.note: Breaking Bad ve Brooklyn Nine-Nine'da sorgu sahneleri.

items.example: Go for a walk and cool down first.
items.simple: You get less angry after some time.
dialogue: A: I'm so angry right now.
B: Take a minute to cool down.
A: Okay. Deep breath.
items.note: Aile kavgalarında öneri olarak.

items.example: Can you fill in for me on Friday?
items.exampleTr: Cuma günü benim yerime bakabilir misin?
items.simple: You do someone's work because they are not there.
dialogue: A: I'm sick. Can someone fill in for me?
B: I'll do it.
A: You're a lifesaver.
items.note: The Office'te vardiya/ofis değişimleri.

items.example: He flaked out on us again.
items.exampleTr: Yine bizi son anda yüzüstü bıraktı.
items.simple: You do not do what you promised, without a good reason.
dialogue: A: Will Ben come tonight?
B: He might flake out.
A: He always does.
items.note: HIMYM ve Friends'te plan bozan arkadaşlar.

items.example: I'll get back at him for the prank.
items.simple: You do something bad to a person because they did something bad to you.
dialogue: A: How will you get back at Jim?
B: With a very big prank.
A: Please be gentle.
items.note: Malcolm in the Middle ve The Office'te şaka savaşları.

items.example: How long can you hold out without sugar?
items.simple: You do not give up for a long time.
dialogue: A: The boss won't hold out much longer.
B: Then we win.
A: Don't say it out loud.
items.note: Pazarlık ve diyet sahnelerinde.

items.example: They hooked up at the wedding.
items.simple: Two people start a short love time; or you connect two things.
dialogue: A: Did Tom hook up with Julie?
B: I think so.
A: I didn't see that coming.
items.note: HIMYM'de Barney'nin günlük kelimesi.

items.example: Feel free to jump in at any time.
items.simple: You join a talk or a job quickly.
dialogue: A: Can I jump in here?
B: Please do.
A: I think we're wrong.
items.note: Toplantı sahnelerinde.

items.example: I mixed up the dates. I'm sorry.
items.simple: You think one thing is another thing by mistake.
dialogue: A: These two bags look the same.
B: I always mix up the keys.
A: Check the tag.
items.note: Komedinin en sık nedeni: yanlış anlama.

items.example: Don't mouth off to your teacher.
items.simple: You say rude things to someone in charge.
dialogue: A: Did you mouth off to Dad?
B: Maybe a little.
A: You're grounded.
items.note: Malcolm in the Middle'da Malcolm ve annesi.

items.example: He's been moping around all week.
items.simple: You walk around and look sad, and you do not do much.
dialogue: A: Don't mope around the house all day.
B: I'm sad, okay?
A: Then eat ice cream.
items.note: Ayrılık sonrası karakterlerde.

items.example: She found out he cheated on her.
items.simple: You are with a new person while you have a partner.
dialogue: A: I think he might cheat on me.
B: Why do you think that?
A: He hides his phone.
items.note: Dram sahnelerinde.

items.example: Sorry to cut in, but your taxi is here.
items.simple: You start to talk when another person is still talking.
dialogue: A: May I cut in?
B: Of course. She's all yours.
A: Thanks, buddy.
items.note: Konuşma ve dans sahnelerinde.

items.example: I'm trying to hold it together at work.
items.simple: You stay calm even when you feel very bad.
dialogue: A: Are you okay?
B: I'm trying to hold it together.
A: You can cry later.
items.note: Friends ve Modern Family'de stresli anlar.
